import type { Finding } from '../lint/finding.ts';

/** An any parameter. */
export function first(value: any): string {
  return String(value);
}

/** An any in a cast and in a type argument. */
export function second(values: Array<any>, finding: Finding): number {
  const loose = finding as any;
  return values.length + Number(loose);
}

/** The word any in a string and as an identifier is fine. */
export function third(): string {
  const any = 'any';
  return any;
}
